summary.text: The Izzet League is a Ravnican guild of experimenters, chemisters and magewrights founded by the dragon Niv-Mizzet.

bio.text: Niv-Mizzet signed the Guildpact and founded the League, and in legend the guild bought the entire goblin tribe for its cleverness.
Niv-Mizzet drove guildmages into ever more dangerous experimental magic, and when Aurelia denounced him the Boros and Izzet collaboration under the Warmind Initiative ended.
When Niv-Mizzet disappeared, Ral Zarek found himself leading the Izzet and became its new guildmaster after over ten thousand years of Niv-Mizzet's rule.
Ral led the Izzet against Bolas in the War of the Spark and convinced the Simic to join.

During the Phyrexian invasion numerous Izzet willingly underwent compleation out of curiosity, earning distrust from other guilds, and Ral curtailed individual research, which sparked intense guild conflict and defections.

status.text: As of the latest story, in August 2024, Niv-Mizzet is shown having taken over and sealed a courtyard in the Ninth District, and the League remains an active Ravnican guild.
